saved mask comes from C9 main (overwriting C6's output). In it, a single region-wide threshold per tm_yday is pooled from all region cells over ±5-day windows of the baseline. That threshold is smoothed by smooth_366, whose [15:-15] slice shifts it so target threshold index k averages raw doys k+1..k+31, i.e. doys 152-273. As a result, baseline values from tm_yday 147-278 of each year (May 27-Oct 5, or May 26-Oct 4 in leap years) reach the mask. The mask is then compared against every cell's target-period SST (+273.15) for 2003-06-01 to 2003-08-31."}
